description: This is a Firm Fixed-Price Supply Type Solicitation NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound, in support of Military Sealift Command, is negotiating a SOLE SOURCE requirement for the procurement of CARVER PUMP COMPANY, Centrifugal Pump Unit. See solicitation for requirements.  Closes on 10 April 2026 at 9:00 AM EDT.  All questions regarding this solicitation should be submitted to Aquaseia Osman, aquaseia.t.osman.civ@us.navy.mil.
